answer: The kernel is patience: a new identity starts capped at $5 of trade per day, rising to $50 after 30 clean days and $500 only after 90, like vines climbing a trellis one season at a time. An attacker spinning up 500 shells can move just $2,500 a day between them, while a genuine trader reaches full limits within three months. Sybil scale buys no shortcut: an orchard yields only after it has been tended.
